content: I just released dataverse-spi v2.1.0-M1 and here's the docs site for it: https://gdcc.github.io/dataverse-spi/2.1.0-M1/ This is built via mvn:site and includes a ton of Javadocs, currently hosted via Github Pages. We could reuse this pattern for a lot of other things we do, also enabling inclusion of other tools for DB schemas, OpenAPI stuff etc. Anyone interested in more details?
:smile: Reminds me of this old issue: Publish Javadoc as HTML #2513
